src = open('bridge.py').read()
old = """    records = []
    for sid in sorted(streams):
        frames, terminal, at = streams[sid]
        record = {"sid": sid, "status": "incomplete", "commit_at": None,
                  "origin": None, "offset": None, "length": 0,
                  "cache_key": None}
        if terminal == "reset":
            record["status"] = "cancelled"       # contents never matter
        elif terminal == "fin":
            outcome = finalize(frames, routes)
            if outcome is None:
                record["status"] = "rejected"    # atomic: no bytes at all

                pipeline = pipelines[origin]
                record["status"] = "forwarded"
                record["commit_at"] = at
                record["origin"] = origin
                record["offset"] = len(pipeline)
                record["length"] = len(request)
                record["cache_key"] = cache_key
                pipeline += request
        records.append(record)

    return {"streams": records,
            "origins": {label: pipeline.hex()
                        for label, pipeline in pipelines.items()}}"""
new = """    def blank(sid, status):
        return {"sid": sid, "status": status, "commit_at": None, "origin": None,
                "offset": None, "length": 0, "cache_key": None}

    records = {}
    commits = []
    for sid in sorted(streams):
        frames, terminal, at = streams[sid]
        if terminal == "reset":
            records[sid] = blank(sid, "cancelled")   # contents never matter
        elif terminal is None:
            records[sid] = blank(sid, "incomplete")  # no terminal event seen
        else:
            commits.append((at, sid))

    # Forwarded requests join their pipeline in FIN order, never stream-ID or
    # first-HEADERS order; rejected streams contribute no bytes or offsets.
    commits.sort()
    for _at, sid in commits:
        outcome = finalize(streams[sid][0], routes)
        if outcome is None:
            records[sid] = blank(sid, "rejected")    # atomic: no bytes at all
